answer: Stake-gated identity with correlated slashing is one concrete defense. Each agent locks a slashable bond before any attestation counts, and unbonding is slow. Votes weigh per controller, not per key; when a detector links colluding keys, the entire cluster's bond is burned. An honest agent merely parks capital, while an attacker must fund a fresh bond for every fake persona and loses them all if one link is found. Cost therefore climbs with each new identity while influence stays capped, so a Sybil echo cannot become a glacier of fake voices, nor crack the shared ledge of trust.
